# Accountant24

> An open source AI agent for personal finance. Runs on your machine, you own the data.

Accountant24 is an open source (Apache 2.0) desktop app for macOS. You log spending, import bank statements and receipts, and ask questions about your money in a chat. The agent keeps proper double-entry books in plain text hledger journal files stored on your machine and versioned with git. It works with any LLM: a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, an API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and more), or local models through Ollama for a fully offline setup.

## Documentation

- [Docs home](https://accountant24.ai/docs): introduction and overview
- [Quickstart](https://accountant24.ai/docs/quickstart): download, connect an LLM, log the first transaction
- [Use cases](https://accountant24.ai/docs/use-cases): what you can do with Accountant24
- [Go fully local](https://accountant24.ai/docs/go-fully-local): run with a local Ollama model
- [Comparison](https://accountant24.ai/docs/comparison): Accountant24 vs YNAB, Monarch, Actual Budget, and hledger
- [FAQ](https://accountant24.ai/docs/faq): privacy, offline use, supported LLMs, pricing, data format
- [Full docs index for LLMs](https://accountant24.ai/docs/llms.txt)
